  • Bronze – 20%
  • Prata – 25%
  • Ouro – 30%
  • Diamante – 35%

O Buddha Spa é a maior rede de Spas Urbanos do país, com unidades em diversas cidades e estados. Nossas unidades estão localizadas em imóveis de rua, dentro de hotéis, condomínios, shoppings, salões e academias, sempre buscando nos aproximar de nossos clientes.

Com foco em serviços de bem-estar, relaxamento e estética, oferecemos mais de 25 tipos de terapias, desde massagens corporais, banhos, tratamentos estéticos avançados, Day Spas, além de procedimentos exclusivamente voltados para o público masculino, gestantes e pós-parto.

A essência do trabalho do Buddha Spa se assenta nos valores do “sentir-se bem”, em todos os aspectos. Buscamos entregar a nossos clientes muito mais do que o atendimento técnico de cada serviço, propiciando uma experiência única. O despertar dos 5 sentidos é a base do atendimento de nossos clientes, os quais usufruem de uma infra-estrutura de alto padrão totalmente voltada para o bem-estar: sons, aromas e chás complementam o toque profissional de cada um de nossos terapeutas.

title: Compliance Analyst
description:
About Crown

We exist to make money work better. That means eliminating the friction of integrating the Brazilian Real into the blockchain economy without sacrificing trust, safety, or compliance.

With the conviction that programmable money is the future of finance, we built BRLV . Anchored by a 1:1 backing of sovereign Brazilian treasury assets, BRLV is the safe, scalable settlement layer designed for the tokenized economy.

We’re backed by Framework, Valor, Norte, Coinbase Ventures, Paxos, and Nubank co‑founder Ed Wible. Our goal: R$1 trillion of BRLV in circulation within 10 years.

The Role

As a Compliance Analyst at Crown, you will be a cornerstone of our risk management framework, operating across both the first and second lines of defense. You will serve as the primary compliance liaison for our institutional clients and partners, guiding them through our rigorous due diligence process while performing critical risk analysis to protect the firm. This role requires a unique blend of client‑facing communication skills and deep analytical rigor. You will work directly with the Chief Compliance Officer and the broader risk function to implement and uphold our institutional‑grade AML/CFT Policy.

  • Institutional Onboarding (1st Line): Act as the main point of contact for institutional clients during the entire onboarding lifecycle. You will guide them through the appropriate Due Diligence Questionnaire (for Brazilian, U.S., or other non‑U.S. entities), ensuring all mandatory documentation—such as constitutional documents, AML/CFT policies, and ownership charts—is collected completely and accurately.
  • Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Risk Assessment (2nd Line): Conduct comprehensive reviews of prospective clients, applying our risk‑based approach. This includes analyzing complex corporate structures to identify and verify Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) according to our dynamic thresholds.
  • Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Execute enhanced due diligence for high‑risk clients, including Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), VASPs, and other financial institutions. This involves a critical assessment of the client’s own AML program, their independent audit reports, and the source of their funds and wealth.
  • Transaction Monitoring Support (2nd Line): Assist in the analysis of alerts generated by our on‑chain and fiat transaction monitoring systems. You will investigate atypical activity, adhering to strict internal SLAs for resolution (e.g., 24 hours for critical alerts), and prepare dossiers for potential Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to be submitted to COAF.
  • Record Keeping and Data Protection: Ensure all due diligence, risk assessments, and client communications are meticulously documented and securely stored, in compliance with our policies and regulatory requirements. You will handle highly sensitive client data and must adhere strictly to our Information Security Policy and data protection principles (LGPD).

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You have 3+ years of experience in a compliance, KYC/AML, risk, or client onboarding role within a VASP, fintech, or regulated financial institution.
  • You have a deep and practical understanding of Brazilian AML/CFT regulations (e.g., Law 14.478/22, COAF reporting) and are familiar with international FATF standards.
  • You are fluent in both Portuguese and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills required to interact with sophisticated institutional clients and internal stakeholders.
  • You have a highly analytical mindset and an obsessive attention to detail, capable of dissecting complex legal and corporate structures to identify underlying risks.
  • You thrive in ownership-driven environments. You’re highly accountable for your work and don’t require others following up on it.
  • You naturally operate cross-functionally, with strong collaborative instincts toward legal, operations, and technology teams.
  • You are energized by the challenge of building and refining compliance processes from the ground up in a fast-paced environment.

What’s Different About Working Here

  • Small by design. We don’t hire layers of managers. Everyone builds.
  • Ownership is total. You own the function end‑to‑end—and ask for input when it makes the work better, not because someone’s checking.
  • Ruthlessly simple. We don’t paper over complexity with process or headcount.
  • Collaboration is default. Problems are shared property. We work across domains.
  • Feedback is candid and direct. Built on the assumption that everyone here is smart, competent, and cares.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary
  • Full health coverage
  • VA

title: Document Controller
description:
Advert 2H Offshore is a global engineering contractor specializing in the design, engineering and integrity management of offshore structures, topsides facilities, subsea components and riser and conductor systems for the offshore oil and gas and renewables sectors. Both market sectors require similar engineering skill sets, and our breadth of experience in offshore structures and environments allows us to provide expertise at all stages of a project: feasibility and concept design, detailed design, procurement management, fabrication support, installation support, monitoring, integrity management, asset life extension and decommissioning.
2H Offshore is seeking an experienced Document Controller to join our team and support large-scale subsea engineering projects. The ideal candidate will take ownership of document control processes, ensuring compliance with internal standards and client requirements. •Implement and manage document control procedures aligned with company and client standards

•Coordinate with engineering, procurement, project management, and external stakeholders to manage document workflows and approvals
•Monitor document deadlines and ensure timely distribution of critical information
•Conduct regular audits to verify compliance and data integrity
•Train team members on document control systems and best practices as required
•Interface with client document control systems, ensuring consistency and alignment
•Support preparation of project handovers, final documentation, and close-out packages
Required
•Proven experience as a document controller in the oil & gas or offshore engineering sector, ideally with exposure to subsea projects
•Strong understanding of document control standards, numbering systems, and ISO-based procedures
•Proficiency in document management platforms (e.g., SharePoint, Aconex, OpenText, or client-specific DMS)
•Strong communication skills in English
•Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills
•Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, technical environment
•Familiarity with engineering terminology and project documentation (e.g., drawings, MTOs, technical specs)
•Degree or diploma in engineering, administration, or related field is preferred

Field Compliance Coordinator - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Position : Field Compliance Coordinator with full relocation to Saudi Arabia as a permanent full‑time expatriate. Attractive relocation package. Qualified candidates will be contacted.

Position Description

We are seeking a Field Compliance Coordinator to join our Upstream OE & Compliance Division. The Division is responsible for providing safety support to Upstream Executive Management and various organizations through HSE reporting, safety audits, recommendations, human‑factor guidance, training, major incident investigations, and lessons‑learned creation. Your primary role will support upstream organizations on Process Safety and major incident investigations for onshore and offshore drilling and oil & gas processing plants.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enhance safety standards and procedures such as work permits, process safety, hazard identification, risk management, and emergency preparedness.
  • Develop loss‑prevention, fire‑prevention, and safety standards, procedures, and General Instructions (GIs) for matters not covered by existing resources.
  • Consult with upstream management to facilitate Safety Management System (SMS) enhancement.
  • Create critical safety documents for major activities such as job safety analyses and hazard identification plans.
  • Assist departments in preparing for major safety reviews, including loss‑prevention compliance reviews.
  • Research emerging safety technologies and conduct feasibility studies and cost analyses to identify improved solutions for existing safety problems and regulatory requirements.
  • Act as a process‑safety audit expert during design, construction, commissioning, turnover to operations, ongoing operations, change management, and decommissioning.
  • Develop and deliver safety training material and safe‑work procedures to field personnel.
  • Instruct on safety concepts, practices, and standards (both on‑the‑job and classroom).
  • Direct and participate in preparing major reference manuals documenting corporate and LP safety systems, policies, and procedures (e.g., LP Policy, SMS manual, Safety Handbook, Construction Safety Manual).
  • Facilitate and lead incident investigations, including interviewing witnesses, gathering data, and conducting root‑cause analysis.
  • Facilitate and lead safety audits by identifying non‑compliance with occupational health and safety regulations and advising on improvements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, HSE, or an equivalent accredited program.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in upstream organizations spanning exploration, drilling, and production on both onshore and offshore sites, with at least 5 years in a senior loss‑prevention or fire‑prevention role.
  • Strong technical expertise in process safety disciplines such as design engineering, loss control management, hazard identification, HAZOP reviews, incident investigations, emergency preparedness, response, and safety management systems.
  • Experience with HAZOP and SIL studies is preferred; internationally recognized certifications are advantageous.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by challenging and rewarding professional, technical, and industrial opportunities, and are remunerated accordingly.

Benefits

Permanent expatriate relocation package, competitive compensation, and opportunities for career development within a global energy leader.

Missão do cargo

Garantir que a rede funcione de forma estável , resolvendo problemas técnicos de clientes e da infraestrutura, atuando entre o atendimento N1 e a engenharia/N3 .

Atividades principais

  • Atender chamados escalados pelo N1 (casos que o N1 não conseguiu resolver).
  • Analisar conectividade :
    • Testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio).
    • Identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar):
    • Ver potência RX/TX das ONUs.
    • Ver ONUs flutuando (online/offline).
    • Verificar erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP :
    • Sessões PPPoE travadas.
    • Cliente autenticando e não navegando.
    • Cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução .

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes .
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE .
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping , tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em ao menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar .
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas contam ponto)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT / BNG / BRAS .
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6 .
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA , etc.).
  • Já trabalhou em provedor de internet.
  • Sabe mexer em OLT GPON na prática (ver potência, ONU, porta, erros).
  • Usa Mikrotik ou similar no dia a dia.
  • Consegue resolver a maioria dos problemas sem supervisão.
  • Já trabalhou com redes/provedor.
  • Conhece TCP/IP, PPPoE, VLAN.
  • Atua com OLT GPON + Mikrotik + monitoramento (Zabbix/Grafana) .
  • Entende bem PPPoE, IPoE, VLAN, NAT, CGNAT/BNG .
  • Consegue segurar plantão e dar suporte ao time como referência técnica.

Perfil comportamental

  • Gosta de resolver problema até o fim , sem “empurrar para o outro”.
  • Sabe trabalhar sob pressão, mantendo calma e foco.Boa comunicação com N1, N3 e técnicos de campo .
  • Organização para registrar tudo o que faz.
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a empresa .

  • Sábado, das 09h às 13h

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You\u2019ll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain. Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review the guidelines provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately to

Awards and Acknowledgements

title: Senior Manager, Telecom
description:
Overview

The position is for the Senior Manager, Telecom at FIFA Women’s World Cup . FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Department: Technology

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Senior Telecom Manager is responsible for managing the Telecom Infrastructure planning, delivery, and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties on the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Telecom services pertinent to the tournament and/or associated events within Brazil.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review Telecom Infrastructure design and ensure all aspects of the Telecom deliverables are implemented at venues and offices according to FIFA requirements: Broadcast Contribution Network, Event/Stadium/Offices/Legacy Networks, CATV/IPTV, Cabling, Mobile Network, Radio and Spectrum, Telephony (VoIP), Telecom Rate Card.
  • Actively participate in the scope definition, procurement liaison, supplier selection and onboarding of Telecom and Network suppliers
  • Lead the management of Telecom infrastructure build and implementation, ensuring timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and decommissioning of venues.
  • Overseeing the effective and efficient provision of Telecom services for FIFA Offices, Tournaments and Events at select FIFA Events.
  • Track the progress of Telecom Infrastructure implementation, report status, issues and risks related to Telecom Infrastructure projects and operations, according to IT governance and keep counterpart aligned.
  • Manage an international Team of Telecom Experts/Managers including remote personnel in other countries/time zones.
  • Liaise with and/or support other projects in clarifying requirements, adhering to robust change management protocol.
  • Ensure that all information pertaining to the delivery and support of Telecom Infrastructure are communicated to and well understood by all parties.
  • Deliver technical guidance, coaching & mentoring to team members, including preparation of good practice and educational material for personnel.

Your Profile

  • University degree or similar higher education in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum experience of 8-10 years in Network (routing/switching/security/wireless technologies)
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex Telecom Infrastructure Projects
  • Experience in Management of distributed international team of telecom experts and professionals
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in Telecom Infrastructure Service, including infrastructure design and implementation, network integration and connectivity.
  • Broad understanding of Telecom Infrastructure and Information Technologies in Sport Events with sufficient experience in design, commissioning and operation of BCN, WAN/MAN/LAN, MPLS, VLAN, VoIP, CATV/IPTV, Multicast, Spectrum, Mobile Networks
  • Good Procurement and contract management skills
  • Aptitude for consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent people management, verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Team player, willing to work with tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR/ ES/ GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 20%), with some trips lasting 15 days or more
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

Seniority level

  • Mid-Senior level

Employment type

  • Contract

Job function

description:
Engenheiro de Projetos de Perfuração - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Join to apply for the Engenheiro de Projetos de Perfuração - Rio de Janeiro/RJ role at Infotec Brasil

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Concepção de projeto de perfuração;
  • Análise e cadastro de insumos;
  • Análise e elaboração de resumo de ocorrências dos poços de correlação;
  • Elaboração ou avaliação de estudo de geopressões, geomecânica e estimativa de fechamento;
  • Assentar sapatas atendendo às normas de segurança e ao escopo do projeto;
  • Classificar a criticidade de poço;
  • Disponibilização dos insumos para projetos especializados e estimativa de duração e custos;
  • Preenchimento dos dados básicos no sistema de projetos e no de orçamentação;
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de estudos de geologia e caracterização biológica do leito marinho;
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de diagrama de restrições para operações em poços offshore;
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de documento declaratório de formações com potencial de fluxo;
  • Solicitação de estrutura analítica de projetos (EAP);
  • Solicitação de estudos especializados de perfuração de poços (projetos de revestimento, cabeça de poço, fluidos, BHA, direcional, perfilagem, alargamento e testemunhagem);
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de riser analysis e WSOG;
  • Solicitação de estimativa de duração probabilística da intervenção;
  • Condução de reunião de pré-projeto, de GEP (Grupo de Empreendimento de Poço) de planejamento, GEP de execução e de planejamento integrado de poço;
  • Participação nas reuniões operacionais, de gestão de mudança de seus poços, de CCAPE e CCAPD dos poços por ele projetados e dos eventos de lições aprendidas;
  • Elaboração dos documentos resultantes do projeto de perfuração (dados básicos, resumo executivo de FEL, cronograma executivo de perfuração e book de projetos);
  • Elaboração de documentos para órgãos externos (parceria, ANP e demais órgãos);
  • Preencher o checklist de perfuração em sistema;
  • Suporte ao coordenador de GEP durante toda a execução e passagem de serviço do poço;
  • Participação nas reuniões do poço projetado (como análises de risco e gestão de mudança);
  • Elaboração de análise preliminar de riscos, conforme padrões e normas;
  • Avaliação de sondas quanto otimização a segurança operacional contemplando, mas não limitado aos seguintes itens (Capacidade de corte do BOP, disponibilidade de EDS’s, avaliação do sistema de compensação e de posicionamento dinâmico da unidade e dos obstáculos na locação);
  • Elaboração de gestões de mudança de projeto;
  • Suportar a elaboração do documento de passagem de serviço dos poços (Handover);
  • Suportar a elaboração das análises de envelope operacional e conjunto solidários de barreiras.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação: Curso de Nível Superior em Engenharia em instituição reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC) ou outro órgão do governo federal destinado a esse fim, com registro no respectivo Conselho de Classe.
  • Experiência: Em projeto e/ou execução de perfuração de poços de petróleo offshore.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Competência de Dados — tratamento, transferência, coleta, organização, agrupamento, noções de análise estatística, árvore de decisão; Pacote Office: Word, Excel, Power Point; Power BI: Noções, filtros, organização dos dados, pesquisa. Operação básica com dados; Noções de projeto de poço marítimo; Noções de construção de poço direcional, vertical e horizontal como operador e como projetista: premissas básicas de projetos, limitações e boas práticas em projetos e execução; Noções de equipamentos de sondas de perfuração; Noções de conceitos básicos de perfuração direcional; Conhecimento de ferramentas direcionais: motores de fundo, rotary steerable e turbinas de perfuração (seleção, limites operacionais, vantagens e desvantagens e operação); Noções de ferramentas de mapeamento de poço: MWD, GWD, Gyro; Noções de ferramentas de perfilagem: LWD e ferramentas a cabo. Limites e operação (poço aberto e poço revestido); Influência do direcional nas descidas a cabo por gravidade; Noções de projeto de BHA: tubulares, alargadores, escareadores, percussores de perfuração; Noções de operação e projeto utilizando sistemas de alargamento (alargadores, ferramentas de eliminação de offset broca x alargador em manobra única, estabilização no poço alargado etc.); Noções de simulação: torque e drag, hidráulica de poço e desgaste de revestimento; Noções de brocas de perfuração: seleção e cálculo de hidráulica; Noções de hidráulica de poço: correlação entre limpeza de poço e geometria de trajetória; Noções de segurança de poço e análise anticolisão entre poços; Noções de geologia e geodésia; Noções de orçamentação de poços; Noções de operação e projeto de testemunhagem; Noções de operações e projeto de canhoneio; Noções de operações e projeto de MPD; Noções básicas dos tipos de completação (contenção de areia, completações simples e inteligentes, etc.); Noções básicas sobre cimentação, recimentação e correção da cimentação; Aplicação do canhoneio nos diferentes tipos de completação (cargas e densidades); Noções básicas de workover e de abandono; Noções básicas de caracterização de reservatório (geologia, geofísica e avaliação de reservatórios); Idiomas: Português (Brasil) - escrita e oral – nível fluente; Inglês técnico - escrita e oral - nível intermediário; Possuir noções básicas de construção de poços marítimos e dos equipamentos e sistemas de unidades de perfuração marítima; Desejáveis noções básicas em brocas, perfuração direcional, MPD, integridade de poços, estabilidade geomecânica de poços, fundações de poços, fluidos de perfuração, cimentação e equipamentos que compõem a estrutura de poços (cabeça de poço, revestimentos etc).

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast‑growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on‑boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

About the project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem‑solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases. You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups.

How to get started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

  • Excellent analytical thinking: can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications

We also value applicants who have

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design
  • Background in consulting, academia, olympiads (e.g. logic/math/informatics), or research
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI‑generated content
  • Familiarity with QA or test‑case thinking (edge cases, failure modes, “what could go wrong”)
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.)

description:
Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Full relocation to Saudi Arabia – permanent full-time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview: We are seeking a Plant Corrosion Engineer to join the Riyas Engineering Division (RNGLFD) which is part of the Riyas NGL Fractionation Dept (RNGLFD).

RNGLFD is responsible for two trains, each designed to process 255 MBOD (242.25 MBCD). Each train will include fractionation units, C3 & C4 treatment, C3 & C4 dehydration and propane refrigeration. The common facilities will include feed and product surge storage, chemicals storage and utilities including, but not limited to, steam and condensate recovery systems, utility water, plant, instrument air and nitrogen systems, machinery cooling water, drainage and flare systems. Some of the systems (e.g., steam headers, flare headers, product storage) have been pre-invested for the future train.

Your primary role will be to implement, support and continually improve RNGLFP inspection corrosion management programs and provide consolatory advice in materials, ensuring cost effective material selection and corrosion mitigation strategies, which will ensure mechanical integrity of the materials, applied on all plant assets including equipment and piping through their life cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement corrosion management program and on-stream monitoring and Conduct risk-based inspection based on API-580 methodology.
  • Review and approve recommended solutions for coating failures and cathodic protection and participate in HAZOP review sessions and ensure that all issues are addressed.
  • Manage water treatment program and recommend solutions to overcome challenges and review design packages and validate materials selection based on current code and standards.
  • Validate corrosion controls corrosion controls, corrosion (CCD), corrosion loops and corrosion damage mechanisms frequently.
  • Assess FEED composition changes and approve recommended solution to assure assets integrity.
  • Develop scope and description of technology items, and lead field implementation.
  • Develop and transfer knowledge about use of coating, Cathodic protection (CP), corrosion inhibitors and other corrosion controls and best practices.
  • Extract data and draw conclusions from Corrosion Monitoring Technologies, and troubleshoot corrosion problems and address root causes.
  • Perform the regular review and update on the plants Integrity Operating Windows (IOW) and Corrosion loops drawings shall be updated by adding emerging damage mechanisms or removing damage mechanisms because of plant upgrades.
  • Adjust and modify inspection practices and programs shall be reflected based on such modifications and perform special studies in corrosion control. Evaluates data as to scope, impact and long-range cost effectiveness on existing and new projects.
  • Review operations and monitoring activities to identify needed system modifications or procedural changes associated with corrosion control with conduct corrosion mitigation and integrity review to optimize the inspection and corrosion programs and maintain assets integrity.

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably in mechanical engineer.
  • 15 years' experience processing in Oil/Gas Industry.
  • Demonstrate experience in material science and metrology, different NDT technology and their applications and knowledge in engineering aspect of welding.
  • Strong Knowledge of international standards and codes NACE, ASME, API and ASTM especially inspection and corrosion standards such as API-571, API-580, API-570 and API-510.
  • Valid NACE Specialist Certification or NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist or combination of NACE Corrosion Technologist, API-571 and NACE CP level II.

PROJETISTA ELETROMECÂNICO DE LINHAS DE TRANSMISSÃO - RIO DE JANEIRO

SOBRE A NIP DO BRASIL
Somos uma empresa de engenharia consultiva especializada em soluções para infraestrutura, energia e meio ambiente. Atuamos com inovação, precisão técnica e responsabilidade socioambiental. Nossa missão é transformar desafios em soluções sustentáveis, gerando impacto positivo para o Brasil e suas comunidades.

Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, inclusivo e focado no desenvolvimento humano. Na NIP, cada pessoa tem espaço para crescer e contribuir com propósito.

Missão da Posição

Atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos eletromecânicos de linhas de transmissão até 138kV, com foco em qualidade técnica, atendimento aos requisitos normativos e prazos contratuais. Contribuir de forma estratégica para o desempenho dos projetos da NIP, liderando entregas técnicas, interações com clientes e acompanhando a equipe de engenharia.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Levantar dados preliminares de campo e referências técnicas (topografia, georreferenciamento, interferências, servidões, condicionantes ambientais).
  • Definir traçado da linha, escolher o melhor percurso considerando restrições técnicas, ambientais e custos, com otimização de rota.
  • Dimensionar eletromecânica e elétrica da linha (condutores, para-raios, isoladores, espaçamentos, esforços de tração e flecha), incorporando critérios de amortecimento, vibração e fadiga.
  • Projetar estruturas de sustentação (torres, postes), definindo tipologia, perfis, empenos, cargas de vento, gelo (quando aplicável) e requisitos de fabricação.
  • Projetar fundações para torres / postes com base nos levantamentos geotécnicos e cargas atuantes.
  • Elaborar memoriais descritivos e memoriais de cálculo que detalhem hipóteses adotadas, normas aplicadas, critérios de dimensionamento e justificativas técnicas.
  • Produzir desenhos executivos e detalhamentos (plantas, cortes longitudinais e transversais, arranjos, fixações, grampos, emendas).
  • Definir o sistema de aterramento das estruturas e condutores, malha de terra compatível com segurança elétrica e regulamentos.
  • Realizar compatibilização técnica com disciplinas complementares (civil, proteção, telecomunicações, automação), garantindo integração dos projetos.
  • Aplicar e garantir conformidade com normas nacionais e internacionais (ABNT, IEC, normas de concessionárias) e regulamentos setoriais.
  • Adaptar projetos conforme requisitos contratuais de clientes ou exigências de concessionárias / clientes, acompanhando revisões e solicitações.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com clientes, fornecedores, órgãos reguladores e equipes de obra para alinhamento de soluções, esclarecimento de dúvidas e decisões de projeto.
  • Acompanhar cronogramas de projeto, distribuir tarefas entre equipe de projetistas, revisar entregas, monitorar prazos e qualidade técnica.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais para acompanhamento de status do projeto, performance da equipe, indicadores de progresso e apoio à gestão.
  • Apoiar a execução da obra fornecendo suporte técnico, esclarecimentos de campo, checagem de conformidade entre projeto e execução e ajustes quando necessário.
  • Garantir que o projeto atenda requisitos de confiabilidade, manutenibilidade, durabilidade e segurança elétrica ao longo do ciclo de vida da linha.

Requisitos Técnicos

Escolaridade / Qualificação Desejada: Técnico em Eletrotécnica

  • Técnico em Eletrônica ou Eletroeletrônica
  • Técnico em Desenho de Projetos ou Técnico em Edificações (com experiência em projetos elétricos)
  • Technólogo em Sistemas Elétricos, Energias Renováveis ou Projetos Industriais
  • Desejável Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrotécnica, Engenharia Eletromecânica ou Engenharia de Energia.
  • Conhecimentos Avançados em softwares de cálculo e modelagem elétrica/mecânica (ex: Autocad, PLS‑CADD, MATLAB, AutoCAD, ferramentas de análise de estruturas).
  • Residir em Fortaleza - CE;
  • Nível avançado em PLS-CADD;
  • Nível intermediário em Excel.

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde Unimed Nacional (empresa cobre 80%, colaborador 20%)
  • Convênio com instituições de ensino (graduação e pós‑graduação)
  • TotalPass (academias)
  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Transporte
  • Seguro de Vida

Compromisso com a Diversidade

A NIP do Brasil valoriza a diversidade e a inclusão em todas as suas formas. Todas as candidaturas são bem‑vindas, independentemente de gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, religião, idade ou deficiência. Nosso compromisso é construir um ambiente onde todos possam prosperar.

The Tech Lead Manager will guide a team of Data Scientists, support planning and prioritization across initiatives and collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to drive clarity, alignment and iterative value delivery.   • Guide end‑to‑end solution development, ensuring scalability, maintainability and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with other leaders to evolve shared frameworks, processes and best practices.
  • Promote a culture of iteration, incremental value delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Stay up to date with modern ML and AI trends, especially around LLMs and emerging technologies.

Requirements

  • Degree in a STEM field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, etc.).
  • Experience leading Data Science teams or mentoring senior‑level Data Scientists.
  • Strong hands‑on expertise in AI, Machine Learning, Python and SQL.
  • Solid knowledge of ML frameworks such as Scikit‑Learn, TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch.
  • Proven experience designing, building and deploying ML solutions in production.
  • Excellent communication skills for engaging with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem solver with ability to manage and lead the team to push solution & progress.
  • Experience working collaboratively with Product and Engineering organizations.
  • English proficiency required.

Differentials

  • Experience in the industrial or manufacturing sector.

  • Experience with cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).

title: Psicólogo - Nefrologia | Banco de Talentos
description:
Já pensou em fazer parte do crescimento da maior provedora de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal em todo o mundo? Todas as nossas ações convergem para um só objetivo: promover a saúde e o bem-estar do paciente. Queremos criar um futuro que vale a pena viver!
QUEM SOMOS:
A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.
Graças a este compromisso, a Fresenius Medical Care tornou-se a maior provedora mundial de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal crônica, uma doença que afeta a mais de 3,2 milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Provemos serviços de diálise por meio de mais de 3.928 clínicas de diálise em todos os continentes, atendendo a mais de 333.331 pacientes.
Descrição :
Responsável por garantir o bom estado geral do paciente renal crônico em tratamento dialítico, colaborando na resolução de problemas psicológicos, trabalhando a autonomia e engajamento do paciente, respeitando sua individualidade.
Garantir a aderência do paciente renal ao tratamento dialítico, analisando e intervindo nas situações de não aderência, assim como nas situações de faltas às sessões de diálise.

  • O que você irá realizar
  • Entrevistar os pacientes novos na unidade, registrando os dados no prontuário do paciente ou meio eletrônico (somente serão registradas informações que tenham relevância ao tratamento dialítico);
  • Acompanhar o estado psicológico do paciente através de atendimento aos pacientes em diálise periodicamente, avaliando a pertinência de intervenções específicas e assistindo individualmente aqueles que necessitem;
  • Favorecer um ambiente adequado de diálise, a fim de propiciar a aderência do paciente ao tratamento, tornando o tempo de diálise em momento produtivo;
  • Trabalhar visando à integração entre pacientes;
  • Orientar os pacientes e familiares proporcionando o acesso envolvimento ao seu tratamento, por meio da educação continuada e juntamente equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Promover a integração da equipe multidisciplinar x pacientes e um apoio para as dificuldades encontradas no lidar com o paciente renal crônico através da realização de reuniões com a equipe de saúde;
  • Promover reuniões periódicas com pacientes, objetivando esclarecer dúvidas e orienta-los quanto às implicações emocionais e comportamentais no tratamento dialítico;
  • Analisar mensalmente relatórios de faltas de pacientes as sessões de diálise e realizar plano de ação visando melhorar a aderência do paciente renal a sessão;
  • Solicitar a presença de pacientes/familiares em eventos sociais auxiliando na promoção destes eventos juntamente com serviço Social;
  • Representar a ouvidoria do paciente junto à Unidade de Diálise e encaminhar reclamações/solicitações pertinentes aos setores competentes;
  • Garantir o registro das informações psicológicas do paciente através da confecção das evoluções periódicas no prontuário do paciente ou me meio eletrônico;
  • Participar de processos institucionais, programas e/ou projetos corporativos estabelecendo um relacionamento adequado com os clientes externos e internos;
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões técnicas, administrativas e multidisciplinares (Reuniões de Qualidade, PCPIEA, etc) da unidade visando melhoria continua dos resultados da unidade;
  • Participar de reuniões e resultados clínicos da unidade, visando à elaboração de plano de ação para situações (Relatório de faltas às sessões, problemas relacionados à não aderência, e outros);
  • Garantir a autorização para atuar na empresa através do cumprimento das obrigações legais mediante ao Conselho Regional de Psicologia assim como cumprir e fazer cumprir o código de ética e atendimento aos requisitos legais.
  • Esperamos que você tenha
  • Ensino Superior completo em Psicologia;
  • CRP ativo e regular;
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento clínico em Nefrologia;
  • Desejável especialização em Psicologia Clínica;
  • Disponibilidade para cumprir 30 horas semanais e/ou 44 horas semanais
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro
  • Oferecemos: Salário e Benefícios compatíveis ao mercado.

Na Fresenius oferecemos oportunidades iguais para todos os profissionais qualificados, independentemente de gênero, raça, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica; proporcionando respeito mútuo, ambiente saudável e motivador a todos.

Reporting to the Financial Systems Lead, this position supports CI’s current financial systems (Unit4 Business World and SAP Concur) and future systems, including a new cloud-based ERP system (Workday). The main focus is to support day‑to‑day operations by responding to help‑desk requests from system users globally and managing system security. This role also supports the generation of special financial and budget reports through SQL queries and advanced Excel applications as needed, and supports enhancement and development of existing and new applications, including design, data validation, testing, and training.

To be successful, you will need strong technical aptitude, experience as a user and a system manager, understanding of accounting and financial reporting, good customer service and communication skills, and the ability to triage and reprioritize case load. Patience with diverse user skill levels and determination to resolve issues timely are essential.

Responsibilities

  • Provide an approachable and responsive helpdesk service, supporting users of CI’s financial applications (Unit4 Business World and SAP Concur) globally.
  • Triage system issues/bugs raised by business users and work to find solutions.
  • Escalate complex issues as necessary, working with internal and external third parties to facilitate resolution.
  • Ensure timely follow‑up, resolution, and documentation of service requests.
  • Maintain financial system integrity, including setting up, administering, and terminating user accounts and maintaining complex workflow structures.
  • Support data quality checks and monitor changes to keep system records up‑to‑date.
  • Work with system providers and IT to facilitate installation and migration of software patches and upgrades.
  • Create and maintain system configuration to ensure optimal processing.
  • Assist in using, developing, and implementing financial system applications.
  • Support testing activities on finance projects, assisting with UAT for new systems, processes, and updates affecting finance operations.
  • Design special‑purpose reports for audits or other management uses.
  • Design processes and procedures for getting data into and out of financial systems as needed.
  • Maintain custom reports and forms in BW using BW report engine tools.
  • Maintain AG16s (SQL‑based customizations) in BW.
  • Participate in ad‑hoc tasks or projects as assigned by the supervisor.

Working Conditions

Guidance on flexible work arrangements will be shared during the interview process.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
  • 4‑6 years of related experience in providing support for financial systems as a super user or system administrator.
  • Understanding of accounting processes and standards.
  • Solid working knowledge of relational and/or OLAP databases.
  • Experience working with MS SQL Server.
  • Experience with ERP reporting tools, particularly Power BI.
  • Accuracy and strong attention to detail.
  • Analytical mindset.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey financial or technical information to non‑financial/technical stakeholders.
  • Pro‑active problem‑solving approach.
  • Ability to plan own workload and resolve conflicting priorities, accountable for own actions.
  • Flexibility and adaptability.
  • Continually seeking ways to improve processes.
  • Passion, drive, and curiosity to challenge and ask questions.
  • English is the working language of the organization and this role.

Preferred

  • Experience with Business World Financials, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Purchasing, Timesheets, and reporting modules.
  • Familiarity with Unit4 BW reporting tools and SQL‑based customizations (AG16s).
  • Cloud‑based ERP system implementation experience (e.g., Unit4 ERPx, Microsoft Dynamics F&O, Workday).
  • Experience with Workday Financials, Adaptive, or other Workday products.
  • Experience with SAP Concur administration.
  • Experience in the INGO sector.
  • Foreign language fluency, especially Spanish, French, and Portuguese.

To apply
